title: First Friday Out
setting: 8pm. Toit, Indiranagar. The first round is already in. Karthik flags you down across the rooftop — he's saved you a chair next to him and someone's half-empty pint of dark beer is waiting at your spot.

beats.native: ಬಂದ್ಯಾ ಬಾಸ್! ನಿನ್ನ pint already ordered. Ee dark ale try ಮಾಡು — ಒಳ್ಳೆಯದು.
beats.translit: bandyā bās! ninna pint already ordered. ee dark ale try māḍu — oḷḷeyadu.
beats.en: You're here, boss! Pint already ordered for you. Try this dark ale — it's good.
beats.beat: claps your shoulder hard enough that you spill a little

beats.native: Guys, ಇವನು ನಮ್ಮ new joinee. Last week ಬಂದಿದ್ದಾನೆ — already ಒಳ್ಳೆ flat ಸಿಕ್ಕಿದೆ. Indiranagar!
beats.translit: guys, ivanu namma new joinee. last week bandiddāne — already oḷḷe flat sikkide. Indiranagar!
beats.en: Guys, this is our new joinee. Came last week — already got a good flat. Indiranagar!
beats.beat: to the table at large. heads turn.

beats.prompt: You raise your glass. You say:

choices.native: ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ! ಒಳ್ಳೆ ಜನ ಸಿಕ್ಕಿದ್ರು ಅಂತ Karthik ಹೇಳಿದ.
choices.translit: namaskāra ellarigū! oḷḷe jana sikkidru anta Karthik hēḷida.
choices.en: Hi everyone! Karthik said I'd meet good people here.
Hey, nice to meet you all.

beats.native: Yaaru helideyo Karthik ಒಳ್ಳೆ ಜನ ಸಿಗ್ತಾರೆ ಅಂತ? ನಾವೆಲ್ಲ ಕೆಟ್ಟವರು. Especially ee Suresh — boss is watching, boss is watching ಅಂತ ಹೇಳ್ತಾ ಇರ್ತಾನೆ.
beats.translit: yāru helideyo Karthik oḷḷe jana sigtāre anta? nāvella keṭṭavaru. especially ee Suresh — boss is watching, boss is watching anta hēḷtā irtāne.
beats.en: Who said Karthik's people are good? We're all bad. Especially this Suresh — keeps saying 'boss is watching, boss is watching'.
beats.beat: the table laughs. someone protests in Tamil. it gets louder.

beats.native: Anyway. Two rules ಬಾಸ್. Manager Ravi ಗೆ promise ಮಾಡಬೇಡ Friday EOD. ಅವನು ಎಲ್ಲ remember ಮಾಡ್ತಾನೆ. And ee canteen sambar ಮಾತ್ರ — bisi bele bath skip.
beats.translit: anyway. two rules bās. manager Ravi-ge promise māḍabēḍa Friday EOD. avanu ella remember māḍtāne. and ee canteen sambar mātra — bisi bele bath skip.
beats.en: Anyway. Two rules, boss. Never promise Manager Ravi anything by Friday EOD — he remembers everything. And in the canteen — only the sambar. Skip the bisi bele bath.
beats.beat: his hand wraps around the back of your chair — you're in

beats.native: Ee ee, that's how we keep ee boy! ಮುಂದಿನ ವಾರ Saturday — colleague ಒಬ್ಬನ housewarming. ನೀನು ಬರಬೇಕು.
beats.translit: ee ee, that's how we keep ee boy! mundina vāra Saturday — colleague obbana housewarming. nīnu barabēku.
beats.en: Ee ee, that's how we keep this boy! Next Saturday — a colleague's housewarming. You're coming.
beats.beat: not a question. you're in the calendar now.
